devdoc.details: This library handles deposits to and withdrawals from Fuse liquidity pools.

approve(address,address,uint256).details: Approves tokens to Fuse without spending gas on every deposit.

params.amount: Amount of the specified token to approve to Fuse.
params.cErc20Contract: The CErc20 contract address of the token.
params.erc20Contract: The ERC20 contract address of the token.

deposit(address,uint256).details: Deposits funds to the Fuse pool. Assumes that you have already approved >= the amount to Fuse.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to be deposited.
params.cErc20Contract: The CErc20 contract address of the token.

getBalance(address).details: Returns the fund's balance of the specified currency in the specified Fuse pool.

params.cErc20Contract: The CErc20 contract address of the token.

transferAll(address,address).details: Transfers all funds from the Fuse pool.

params.cErc20Contract: The CErc20 contract address of the token.

withdraw(address,uint256).details: Withdraws funds from the Fuse pool.

params.amount: The amount of tokens to be withdrawn.
params.cErc20Contract: The CErc20 contract address of the token.

withdrawAll(address).details: Withdraws all funds from the Fuse pool.

params.cErc20Contract: The CErc20 contract address of the token.
